_doc: World map regions. Bounds are x/z metres (north = -z) in the same space as WorldGen. status: current (fully charted, drawn from the baked terrain), unexplored (placeholder shown as 'Unexplored lands' beyond the border). To add a region later: append an entry here, give it status 'current' or 'known' once its terrain exists, and the map will show it.
